subject: health
title: Healthy Foods
about: Why we drink water, the five food groups and why we eat from all of them, half a plate of fruits and vegetables, healthy snacks, and where foods come from (plant or animal, grown on farms). NC 1.NPA.1; nutrition units usually run in late winter and spring.
tip: At dinner, ask him which food group each thing on his plate belongs to.

cards.q: What does your body need to drink every day?
cards.note: Water is the best drink for your body.

cards.q: When your body needs water, how do you feel?
cards.note: Feeling thirsty means your body needs more water. Take a drink!

cards.q: Why do we need to drink water?
cards.a: to keep our body working well
cards.note: Drink extra water when you are hot and sweaty.

cards.q: How many food groups are there?
cards.note: The five groups are fruits, vegetables, grains, protein and dairy.

cards.q: Which food group are apples and bananas in?
cards.note: Berries, oranges and grapes are fruits too.

cards.q: Which food group are carrots and broccoli in?
cards.note: Peas, peppers and spinach are vegetables too.

cards.q: Which food group are bread and rice in?
cards.note: Grains come from plants like wheat, rice and oats.

cards.q: Which food group are milk, cheese and yogurt in?
cards.note: Dairy foods are made from milk.

cards.q: Which food group are chicken, eggs and fish in?
cards.note: Protein foods help build strong muscles.

cards.q: What should fill half of your plate?
cards.note: Make half your plate fruits and vegetables at each meal.

cards.q: Which one is a healthy snack?
cards.note: Fruit, veggies and yogurt make good snacks too.

cards.q: Why do we eat foods from all five groups?
cards.a: to help our body grow strong
cards.note: Each food group gives your body something it needs.
Farmers milk cows. Goats give milk too.
A hen is a girl chicken. Hens lay eggs.
Apple trees grow on farms called orchards.
The orange part of a carrot is its root. Roots grow down in the dirt.

cards.q: Where is most of our food grown?
cards.note: Farmers grow plants and raise animals for our food.

cards.q: Does cheese come from a plant or an animal?
cards.note: Cheese is made from milk, and milk comes from animals.
